name: FNB Performance
event_note: seen in the site code, Nov 16

enquiries.label: Profit Review requests
enquiries.how: Count of the generate_lead event the site sends when the Profit Review form is sent successfully.
caveats: The site sends generate_lead when the form is sent ({note}).
Requests made by phone, email or WhatsApp are not counted here.
breakdowns: Page the request was sent from
Which page were requests sent from?
enquiries.reading: Match each request to its reply so none goes unanswered.
enquiries.test: Send one test Profit Review request after accepting cookies; it should show in Analytics Realtime within minutes.
live_q: Which countries were requests sent from?
Which devices were they sent from?

enquiries.label: WhatsApp clicks
enquiries.how: Count of the whatsapp_click event the site sends.
caveats: The site sends whatsapp_click from its Ask buttons ({note}); header and footer links are not yet confirmed.
A click opens WhatsApp; it does not prove a message was sent.
enquiries.test: Tap a WhatsApp button after accepting cookies and check whatsapp_click in Analytics Realtime.
live_q: Where do WhatsApp clicks come from?

enquiries.label: Calculator uses
enquiries.how: Count of the tool_used event the site sends when a calculator is used.
caveats: The site sends tool_used with the calculator name ({note}).
enquiries.param_fallback: The tool parameter is not registered as a custom dimension, so calculators are split by page instead.
enquiries.test: Use one calculator after accepting cookies and check tool_used in Analytics Realtime.
